name: formkurier
description: Build, publish and embed online forms; answers go signed to your own system or are stored encrypted in Germany.

interface.longDescription: Formkurier is an online form service for small businesses, agencies and developers. Its forms either pass every answer straight to the customer's own system as a signed webhook, keeping nothing after delivery, or store answers encrypted on servers in Germany. With the connector you create forms from a short description or from YAML, change fields, publish versions, get the embed code, set and test the webhook, and read or export stored answers of your own workspace. Publishing, archiving, deleting answers and changing the webhook are marked as changes and need your confirmation. Choose read-only or read-and-write access when connecting. Requires a Formkurier account. The tools use the Formkurier API, documented at https://formkurier.com/api-und-agenten (OpenAPI: https://app.formkurier.com/openapi.json).
defaultPrompt: Create a contact form with name, email and message and publish it.
Show the answers of my application form from this week as a table.
Give me the embed code for my booking form.

positive.expected_behavior: List the forms of the connected review workspace with name, status and published version, matching the app.

positive.expected_behavior: Create a draft form with three fields (text, email, textarea; name and email required) and report its id; nothing is published.

positive.prompt: Veröffentliche das Kontaktformular und gib mir den Einbettungscode.

Return a CSV with one row per seeded answer and one column per field key.
